ci_prior_failures: Existing REALITY handshake checks failed at different assertions in attempts 1 and 2. The unchanged commit passed the full checks and build in attempt 3; no tests were skipped or weakened.

deployment.mode: Atomic replacement of 9 scoped files in the existing source bind mount

changes: Statistics acquire shared user locks in numeric ID order and retry the entire atomic transaction at most 3 times.
Online synchronization updates users in ID order and retries its entire database transaction at most 3 times.
Expired status cleanup updates one user per retried transaction and rechecks staleness at write time.
Admin retention converts Horizon minutes to hours: 10080 minutes renders as 168 hours.

verification.natural_cleanup_observation: 29 stale online records immediately after apply; 0 after the following scheduled cleanup. New stale records naturally accumulate between one-minute cleanups.

limits: No natural registration, payment callback, ticket notification or Telegram group eligibility task appeared in this short release window; those end-to-end outcomes were not newly verified.
SMTP acceptance and completed mail jobs do not establish inbox receipt; Telegram device delivery was not tested.
Historical failed jobs and cumulative error logs remain visible. Invalid recipients, invalid callback requests and historical authorization refusals were not treated as current queue failures.
